intent: Analyze system state baseline for thermal throttling and latency issues
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and Potential for Latency Issues
suggested_solution: RCDWR: Try setting to 16 or 8 (depending on the system's stability) to reduce latency.
TWTRS: Try setting to 4, but be aware that it may not be stable.
tRP: Avoid setting to 32 as it is not stable.
VDDQ Voltage: Lowering VDDQ to 1.4V may improve stability and performance.
IOD Voltage: Be cautious when adjusting IOD voltage, as it can affect system stability.
EDC (Enhanced Clock Control): Raising EDC to a moderate value (e.g., 250) may improve L3 performance.
